causalAutopsy.notes: PR2739 intentionally covered only routine Agent Health; other automated egress remained outside the approved Quiet by Default gate. This completes the cross-egress gate and preserves distinct quiet vs delivered outcomes.

guardEvidence.howCaught: A sustained 1000-send mixed producer storm emits zero Telegram calls; an opted-in 500-event storm emits only three immediate pushes plus one bounded window summary. Durable preference attempts settle at eight and successful polling cannot rearm them; eligibility-before-batching prevents starvation. Digest cadence is once per day; failure episodes max three/day. These temporal brakes follow the canonical tests/unit/self-action-convergence.test.ts invariant and are driven through the actual gate in the new integration and route tests.
